content_html:
watched #MissShettyMrPolishetty : Excellent Movie for New age audience…..

First and Foremost I need to talk about the brilliance of the Writer & Director Mahesh Babu…for effortlessly blending a bold subject with subtle comedy and showcasing it in a manner where it appeals to larger audience without making them feel uncomfortable. The witty one liners as well the emotional dialogues, Mahesh Babu has got everything perfectly balanced 🙏 I guess this is his first movie but yet he proved that he belongs to the class of directors like Karan Johar & Imtiaz Ali in conveying bold and mature love stories with ease 😍

Naveen Polishetty is a true actor where his acting capabilities are not only limited to comedy but man he easily topped with his performances in emotional scenes as well…..its just because of his acting that made the chemistry between Anushka and Him so adorable and believable 🙏

Tough Anushka’s physique and screen presence has been impacted due to her weight issues but she was on dot with her acting and suited perfectly for the matured women character

Kudos to the Production house and the director for bringing together a star heroine and an upcoming yet Talented actor together for a bold story which was presented so beautifully and gracefully 🙏🙏🙏 Special mention to the dialogues be it comedy or emotional ones 🫡

The only disappointment I had in this movie was the Standup Comedy parts should have been better and engaging as I felt the normal scenes has more comedy than the stand up parts 😞 Nevertheless I came out of theatre with a satisfaction of watching a Beautiful Bold and Mature Love Story
